purpose: Recheck historical high-upside / double-upside candidates against the 2026-08-10 close and issuer information available by 2026-08-11.
rule: A historical scenario may not become a current target unless current price, a normalized earnings denominator, a current target or reproducible house range, and cash/driver evidence all pass together.
